subtitle: Reliability Center & Player Experience
changes: Added a source-aware Connection & Recovery panel beneath the Live Armory character lookup with clear feedback for success, partial equipment results and failed requests.
Added a matching Item Codex recovery panel and user-controlled Retry Last Entry action that respects the existing form validation and uses the existing official item lookup.
Browser-reported connectivity status now informs retry availability without claiming that Blizzard servers are online or starting background polling.
Status messages distinguish timeouts, connectivity errors, and possible rate limiting while preserving already loaded results and local saved data.
Talent Forge, Gear Mastery, HYPER MUSIC, stored builds, user authentication, hosting and Discord announcement integration remain intact; live player/browser acceptance tests are still pending.
